tasks.objective_text_en: Collect 6 of the treasures that Lafoo digs up and bring them to High-Oracle Soo-say in Rainspeaker Canopy. /  / If you lose Lafoo's Bug Bag, speak to High-Oracle Soo-say in Rainspeaker Canopy.

max_level_bonus_money.rate: 6 copper per base XP at level 80

tasks.name: 议和
tasks.objective_text_zh: 雨声树屋的高阶神谕者索乌塞要你将雨声议和礼物交给萨满祭司维克伊克，然后转达他的回应。 /  / 如果你弄丢了拉弗乌的虫袋，就去找雨声树屋的高阶神谕者索乌塞。
tasks.objective_text_en: High-Oracle Soo-say at Rainspeaker Canopy wants you to give a peace offering to Shaman Vekjik and then return with his response. /  / If you lose Lafoo's Bug Bag, speak to High-Oracle Soo-say in Rainspeaker Canopy.

max_level_bonus_money.rate: 6 copper per base XP at level 80

tasks.route_mechanism_note: 不共享：五号分别完成议和交互。
tasks.fivebox_resolved: 不共享：《议和》五号分别完成。

tasks.name: 这么快就回来啦？
tasks.objective_text_zh: 前往雾语村，与唤雾者索乌甘谈一谈。 /  / 如果你弄丢了亚鲁乌特的宝贝水晶，就去找雨声树屋的高阶神谕者索乌塞。
tasks.objective_text_en: Travel to Mistwhisper Refuge and speak to Mistcaller Soo-gan. /  / If you lose Jaloot's Favorite Crystal, speak to High-Oracle Soo-say in Rainspeaker Canopy.

max_level_bonus_money.rate: 6 copper per base XP at level 80

tasks.name: 被抢走的雾语宝物
tasks.objective_text_zh: 雾语村的唤雾者索乌甘要你杀死督军塔尔特克，并取回雾语宝物。 /  / 如果你弄丢了亚鲁乌特的宝贝水晶，就去找雨声树屋的高阶神谕者索乌塞。
tasks.objective_text_en: Kill Warlord Tartek and retrieve the Mistwhisper Treasure for Mistcaller Soo-gan at Mistwhisper Refuge. /  / If you lose Jaloot's Favorite Crystal, speak to High-Oracle Soo-say in Rainspeaker Canopy.

max_level_bonus_money.rate: 6 copper per base XP at level 80

tasks.route_mechanism_note: 共享：督军塔尔特克击杀共享；雾语宝物交互不共享，五号需要依次交互，物体被取走后等刷新再操作下一号。先杀塔尔特克再处理宝物。
tasks.fivebox_resolved: 混合：《被抢走的雾语宝物》督军塔尔特克击杀共享；宝物交互不共享，需要五号依次等待刷新后操作。

tasks.name: 被迫出手
tasks.objective_text_zh: 雾语村的唤雾者索乌甘要你杀死8个狂心持矛者和6个狂心清除者。 /  / 如果你弄丢了亚鲁乌特的宝贝水晶，就去找雨声树屋的高阶神谕者索乌塞。
tasks.objective_text_en: Kill 8 Frenzyheart Spearbearers and 6 Frenzyheart Scavengers for Mistcaller Soo-gan at Mistwhisper Refuge. /  / If you lose Jaloot's Favorite Crystal, speak to High-Oracle Soo-say in Rainspeaker Canopy.

max_level_bonus_money.rate: 6 copper per base XP at level 80

tasks.name: 回家喽！
tasks.objective_text_zh: 返回雨声树屋。
tasks.objective_text_en: Return to Rainspeaker Canopy.

max_level_bonus_money.rate: 6 copper per base XP at level 80

tasks.name: 愤怒的鳄鱼人
tasks.objective_text_zh: 抵达苔行村后与莫乌德谈一谈。 /  / 如果你弄丢了莫乌德的皮球，就去找雨声树屋的高阶神谕者索乌塞。
tasks.objective_text_en: Travel to Mosswalker Village and speak to Moodle once you've arrived. /  / If you lose Moodle's Stress Ball, speak to High-Oracle Soo-say in Rainspeaker Canopy.

max_level_bonus_money.rate: 6 copper per base XP at level 80

tasks.name: 苔行祭坛的源血碎片
tasks.objective_text_zh: 莫乌德要你去收集10块源血碎片，但是你最好不要进入石柱中的洞穴。 /  / 如果你弄丢了莫乌德的皮球，就去找雨声树屋的高阶神谕者索乌塞。
tasks.objective_text_en: Moodle wants you to collect 10 Lifeblood Shards, but stay away from the cave inside of the pillar itself. /  / If you lose Moodle's Stress Ball, speak to High-Oracle Soo-say in Rainspeaker Canopy.

max_level_bonus_money.rate: 6 copper per base XP at level 80

tasks.route_mechanism_note: 不共享：源血碎片五号分别完成；完成后直接回莫乌德交，不和《苔行村的救星》一起压到最后。
tasks.fivebox_resolved: 不共享：《苔行祭坛的源血碎片》五号分别完成。

tasks.name: 苔行村的救星
tasks.objective_text_zh: 莫乌德要你前往苔行村搭救6名苔行村受害者。也许有些鳄鱼人已经命在旦夕，难以挽救了。 /  / 如果你弄丢了莫乌德的皮球，就去找雨声树屋的高阶神谕者索乌塞。
tasks.objective_text_en: Moodle wants you to rescue 6 of the Mosswalker Victims in Mosswalker Village, though some of them may no longer be alive to save. /  / If you lose Moodle's Stress Ball, speak to High-Oracle Soo-say in Rainspeaker Canopy.

max_level_bonus_money.rate: 6 copper per base XP at level 80

tasks.route_mechanism_note: 共享：完成后直接回莫乌德交。
tasks.fivebox_resolved: 共享：《苔行村的救星》进度五号同步。

tasks.name: 英雄的负担
tasks.objective_text_zh: 杀死残忍的阿图里斯。 /  / 莫乌德无法陪你执行这项任务，因此你最好召集其他伙伴帮忙。
tasks.objective_text_en: Kill Artruis the Heartless. /  / While securing the aid of friends is highly recommended, Moodle will not be able to accompany you on this task.

max_level_bonus_money.rate: 6 copper per base XP at level 80

tasks.route_mechanism_note: 神谕者路线不要爆发秒杀阿图里斯。约30%血量后等亚鲁乌特和泽匹克解除控制，只杀泽匹克并保留亚鲁乌特；继续让亚鲁乌特参与最后阶段后再击杀阿图里斯。战后原地确认亚鲁乌特出现《神谕者之手》，没有出现就不要直接离开，避免整条神谕者后续断掉。
tasks.fivebox_check: 五号统一选择神谕者：阿图里斯约30%血量进入阵营NPC可选阶段后，保留亚鲁乌特并击杀泽匹克；确认一次选择/击杀是否能同步五号，若不同步则各号分别完成。

max_level_bonus_money.rate: 6 copper per base XP at level 80

tasks.objective_text_en: Kill 60 Game Animals while you aid Hemet and his companions in their hunting. When you've killed your 60, return to Drostan at the Nesingwary Base Camp to compare numbers.

max_level_bonus_money.rate: 6 copper per base XP at level 80

tasks.fivebox_check: 确认狩猎动物60只的击杀进度是否共享。

tasks.fivebox_check: 确认始祖龙宝宝是否个人拾取，以及同一个孵化目标能否五号连续取得。

tasks.objective_text_en: The Avatar of Freya wants you defeat Thalgran Blightbringer by using Freya's Ward to reflect his Deathbolts back to him sevenfold.

max_level_bonus_money.rate: 6 copper per base XP at level 80

tasks.objective_text_en: Travel to the Lifeblood Pillar and look for clues to its destruction.

tasks.english_name: Powering the Waygate - The Maker's Overlook

tasks.objective_text_en: The Avatar of Freya wants you to head to the Maker's Overlook in eastern Sholazar Basin and use the Activation Switch Theta.

max_level_bonus_money.rate: 6 copper per base XP at level 80

tasks.objective_text_en: Kill Broodmother Slivina and return to Dorian Drakestalker at Dorian's Outpost.

max_level_bonus_money.rate: 6 copper per base XP at level 80

tasks.objective_text_en: The Avatar of Freya at the Rainspeaker Rapids wants you to use Freya's Horn atop of the Glimmering Pillar.

tasks.objective_text_en: Capture 12 Chicken Escapees for Elder Harkek at Frenzyheart Hill.

tasks.name: 卡塔克的愤怒
tasks.objective_text_zh: 将1份纯净的神谕者的血带去卡塔克的祭坛，召唤出卡塔克。借助他的力量在祭坛附近杀死50个灵鳍鳄鱼人，然后向卡塔克要塞的萨满祭司亚克耶克复命。
tasks.objective_text_en: Bring a pure sample of Oracle Blood to the Altar of Kartak to summon Kartak. With the aid of Kartak's shared powers, slaughter 50 of the nearby Sparktouched Gorlocs for Shaman Jakjek in Kartak's Hold.

extra_objectives.text: Place the blood at the Shrine of Kartak

tasks.objective_text_zh: 雨声树屋的高阶神谕者索乌塞要你带上一名同伴，挖掘并收集6份闪闪发亮的宝贝。 /  / 记得与雨声树屋的高阶神谕者索乌塞谈谈关于帮手的事。

extra_objectives.text: Talk to High-Oracle Soo-say to retrieve a Gorloc companion

max_level_bonus_money.rate: 6 copper per base XP at level 80

tasks.name: 泰坦的意志
tasks.objective_text_zh: 从灵鳍湾附近的狼獾人身上取得1块被污染的水晶，将它带去闪电巨石处，召唤出索乌霍鲁。借助他的力量在神祠附近杀死50个狂心狼獾人，然后向灵鳍湾的唤雷者索乌米特复命。
tasks.objective_text_en: Obtain a Tainted Crystal from the wolvar near Sparktouched Haven and bring it to the Great Lightning Stone to call Soo-holu. With the aid of Soo-holu's shared powers, kill 50 of the nearby Frenzyheart wolvar, then return to Lightningcaller Soo-met near the Great Lightning Stone.

extra_objectives.text: Use the Tainted Crystal at the Great Lightning Stone

max_level_bonus_money.rate: 6 copper per base XP at level 80

tasks.name: 风与水之歌
tasks.objective_text_zh: 索乌尼要你在雷暴台地使用雷雨之鼓，帮助海波恩吞噬3个风暴亡魂和3个流水之魂。
tasks.objective_text_en: Soo-nee wants you to use the Tempest Drums at the Stormwright's Shelf and help Haiphoon devour 3 Storm Revenants and 3 Aqueous Spirits.

extra_objectives.text: Fill Rejek's Vial

tasks.name: 雷耶克：第一滴血

tasks.objective_text_en: Blood Rejek's Blade on the corpses of a Sapphire Hive Wasp, a Hardknuckle Charger, and 3 members of the Mistwhisper Tribe. You may blood the sword on either Mistwhisper Oracles or Mistwhisper Warriors. Return to Rejek at Frenzyheart Hill when your task is complete.

max_level_bonus_money.rate: 6 copper per base XP at level 80

tasks.name: 净化之歌
tasks.objective_text_zh: 雨声树屋的索乌尼要你在苦潮湖、冬拥河和河流之心敲响净化之钟，杀死污染水源的邪灵。
tasks.objective_text_en: Soo-nee, at the Rainspeaker Canopy, wants you to play the Cleansing Chime at Bittertide Lake, Wintergrasp River and River's Heart and slay the evil spirits that plague the waters there.

extra_objectives.text: Use Chime of Cleansing to summon Spirit of Atha
Use Chime of Cleansing to summon Spirit of Ha-Khalan
Use Chime of Cleansing to summon Spirit of Koosu

max_level_bonus_money.rate: 6 copper per base XP at level 80

tasks.objective_text_en: Soo-nee at Rainspeaker Canopy wants you to use the Didgeridoo of Contemplation at the top of the Glimmering Pillar, the Suntouched Pillar, the Mosslight Pillar and the Skyreach Pillar.

max_level_bonus_money.rate: 6 copper per base XP at level 80

tasks.objective_text_zh: 雨声树屋的索乌尼要你前往造物者之座西北方的雷暴台地，在8堆肥沃的土堆附近吹响丰饶号角。

max_level_bonus_money.rate: 6 copper per base XP at level 80

tasks.objective_text_en: Gather 3 Essences of the Monsoon and 3 Essences of the Storm and take them to the Shrine of the Tempest. Return to Rejek at Frenzyheart Hill with the True Power of the Tempest.

max_level_bonus_money.rate: 6 copper per base XP at level 80

tasks.objective_text_zh: 前往斯温迪格林挖掘场，从风险投资公司的驻地搞到风险投资公司炸药，然后使用它们获得风暴看守的头盔。将风暴看守的头盔交给狂心岭的雷耶克。

extra_objectives.text: Use Venture Co. Explosive on dead Stonewatcher

max_level_bonus_money.rate: 6 copper per base XP at level 80

tasks.objective_text_zh: 喝下神秘的狂心氏族饮料，然后在卡塔克要塞附近消灭30个灵鳍鳄鱼人。
tasks.objective_text_en: Using the secret Frenzyheart drink, slaughter 30 of the Sparktouched Gorlocs around Kartak's Hold.

extra_objectives.text: Charge the Dormant Polished Crystal at the exposed Lifeblood Pillar
